## Why it matters

FOCAL opens the Asia Directories and Chronicles as a searchable resource on trade, institutions, and foreign residents across Asia between 1863 and 1941.

It is especially useful for studying connected histories, commercial networks, and everyday colonial-era infrastructures beyond a single nation-state frame.
